metadata.description: Local marketplace for dhx-owned Claude Code plugins. Hosts plugin manifests that register hooks outside settings.json to survive CC's atomic settings-rename clobber (see reports/2026-04-16-shared-settings-rewriter.md).

plugins.name: dhx
plugins.description: dhx SessionStart hooks: health-check cache writer and dirty-tree reporter. Registered here instead of settings.json because plugin-sourced hooks are immune to CC's in-memory settings clobber.

plugins.name: superpowers
plugins.description: Hook-strip fork of superpowers@claude-plugins-official 5.1.0 — the 10-skill closure dhx skills invoke by name, minus the SessionStart mandate injection. Keeps the 'superpowers' plugin name so superpowers:<skill> references resolve unchanged; never enable alongside the official plugin.

plugins.name: roslyn-lsp
plugins.description: C# LSP via Microsoft's official roslyn-language-server (user-local .NET 10 tool). Replaces broken csharp-ls; never enable alongside csharp-lsp@claude-plugins-official.
